Messages.Body:
"Leo-Rick" <leo...@pronet.it> wrote:

>Here we go again:

>My dear friend plays Muddled, then attack my vamps, then does damage =
>with First Strike, then plays Pulled Fangs, and pretends that my poor =
>vamp goes to torpor without dealing a single damage, is that fair?

>Shouldn't Pulled Fangs be played after both combatants stroke?

You are correct. As long as the initial four damage from Muddles
doesn't send you to torpor, you get to strike back before the Pulled
Fangs gets played. If you get that strike in, and Muddles goes to
zero, he won't have a chance to play the Pulled Fangs before being
burned, either...
